why.taken: POWR is at another gym that night
why.quarterUsed: You have a night this quarter

locked.title: Clash Nights come with Clash Pro
locked.body: Four POWR Clash Nights a year, one a quarter, at your gym. We bring the DJ, the photographer and partner prizes, and you pick the dates here.

how.included_one: Your package includes {{count}} Clash Night a year. We bring the DJ, the photographer and partner prizes.
how.included_other: Your package includes {{count}} Clash Nights a year, one a quarter. We bring the DJ, the photographer and partner prizes.
how.notice_one: Pick a night at least {{count}} week ahead. The first date you can pick is {{date}}.
how.notice_other: Pick a night at least {{count}} weeks ahead. The first date you can pick is {{date}}.
how.confirm: POWR gets your request, then confirms the date with you.
how.founding: Founding Pro: pick all four dates now, one in each quarter.

form.backupHint: If we can’t do your first choice, we’ll try this one.
form.notesPlaceholder: How many you expect, a theme, where the DJ can set up…
form.empty: Pick a free date on the calendar. Greyed-out days are too soon, in a quarter you’ve already booked, or taken by another gym.

toast.asked: Asked for {{date}}. POWR will confirm it with you.
toast.callOffConfirm: Call off the Clash Night on {{date}}? POWR will be told straight away.
toast.calledOff: Called off. That quarter is free to book again.

partners.title: Partner discounts

how.title: Buy prizes and kit at the price POWR members pay.

pick.title: Pick a brand
pick.body: Every POWR partner, with the discount our members get.

code.title: Get your code
code.body: One tap when you need it. The same code comes back for a week.

shop.title: Shop
shop.body: Use it at the brand’s checkout, like any discount code.

how.events: Running an event? You can also send everyone who takes part a partner code at the reveal, from the event’s Prizes step.

empty.title: No partner discounts right now
empty.body: New brands join POWR all the time. Check back soon.

partners.footer: These codes are for your gym’s own buying. Members get their own in the POWR app, so please don’t pass them on. Need another code sooner? Email support@powr.life.

card.soldOut: No codes left right now. Check back soon.
card.poolLow_one: Only {{count}} left · one use, held for your gym
card.poolLow_other: Only {{count}} left · one use, held for your gym
card.pool: One use, held for your gym
card.lastCode: Your last code, {{code}}, works until {{date}} if it’s unused.

code.pool: Held for your gym. A new one from {{date}}.
code.shared: The same code POWR members use.
code.link: Shop through it whenever you buy from them.

toast.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select it and copy it instead.

screens.title: Your gym on the big screen
screens.tvTitle: {{title}}, as it shows on the TV

setup.tvTitle: Your leaderboard, before it's switched on
setup.teaserLines: The weekly leaderboard, live on your TV
setup.title: Switch on your screens
setup.body: A weekly leaderboard of points earned at {{gym}}, made for a TV on the gym floor. It resets every Monday, shows last week’s champion and carries a QR code so members can join. You also get Gym Clash: your gym racing every other POWR gym nearby.
setup.linkHint: Lower-case letters, numbers and dashes. It’s part of the link you’ll open on the TV, so pick it once.
setup.ownerOnly: Your gym’s owner can switch the screens on from here.

board.title: Weekly leaderboard
board.blurb: Points earned at {{gym}}, Monday to Sunday, with last week’s champion and a QR code to join. It changes scene by itself and updates every few seconds.
board.paused: Paused — the TV goes blank on its next refresh

near.label: Near
near.hint: A monitor, or a screen behind reception. Everything on.

standard.label: Standard
standard.hint: A 50" TV in a room. A third bigger, a little less on screen.

far.label: Far
far.hint: Across a gym floor. One idea per scene, big enough from the far wall.

league.title: Gym Clash
league.blurb: {{gym}} against the gyms nearby this week, then the whole POWR network, with a head-to-head against the gym just above you.
league.radiusHint: A city needs 10–15 km to catch real neighbours, a town 25–50.

open.title: Open the link
open.body: In the TV’s own browser, or cast a laptop tab to it. Copy the link from the screen you want.

fullScreen.title: Go full screen
fullScreen.body: Press F11 (or the browser’s full-screen button). The board fits any size of screen.

leave.title: Leave it running
leave.body: It refreshes itself, changes scene, and starts a new week every Monday. Nothing to touch.

tv.linksNote: Both links share one key, and a link can only show its board. Keep them to your screens: anyone with a link can open it.
tv.linksNoteOwner: If one has got out, make a new key: every TV on the old links goes blank until you open the new ones.
tv.rotateConfirm: Change the screen link? Any TV showing the old link goes blank until you open the new one on it.
tv.rotated: New link made — open it on your TVs

blurb.post: Pick a template, add a photo or video, and fill it from your events or this week’s board. Save a draft to finish it later.
blurb.pack: Drop a folder, photos or a ZIP from a shoot, pick the event, and get every post it needs in one go — downloaded, and kept here to come back to.
blurb.drafts: Posts saved to finish later. Open one to carry on where it was left — every slide, photo or clip, the words and the look.
